scenes.text: For six years, the deep relay heard nothing from the colony.
scenes.art_prompt: a remote deep-space relay station drifting in darkness, faint antenna dish, stars, cinematic

scenes.text: Then, one night, its beacon returned.
scenes.art_prompt: a single blinking beacon light on a distant planet surface seen from orbit, eerie

scenes.text: The colony had one beacon. It was built for one.
scenes.art_prompt: a small automated beacon module on an empty alien plain, one light, quiet isolation
a cluster of identical beacon lights scattered across a dark plain, unnatural, ominous

scenes.text:
Every log was dated the night the colony went silent.
They had been calling out the whole time. The relay just could not hear them.
scenes.art_prompt: rows of recorded transmission waveforms glowing on an old console, deep space control room

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
scenes.art_prompt: a silent deep-space relay against a vast nebula, stars, quiet and final
